_comment: The 27B served by the llama.cpp router (scripts/setup-llm.ps1, scripts/start-llm.ps1) for the ComfyUI workflow, the chat tab and /coder/turn. The source GGUF is downloaded from Hugging Face (sha256 from its LFS metadata, checked after download) and requantized to 'quant' with llama-quantize so it fits in ~24 GB of shared memory; 'name' is the model name of the router's preset (LLM_MODEL) that the workflows and the chat tab send.
name: qwen3.8-27b-abliterated
